hints: Une durée close dans le passé : had been + -ing + for.

exercises.source: She was tired because she had work all night.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: She was tired because she had been working all night
She was tired because she'd been working all night

hints: Après had been, le verbe prend -ing.

exercises.prompt: The pitch was frozen — it ___ since midnight.

accepted: had been snowing

hints: Le récit est au passé, la durée le précède.

fields.regle: Le past perfect continu dit la durée d'une activité antérieure à un moment passé : « She had been waiting for an hour when he finally called. »

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Elle attendait depuis une heure quand il a enfin appelé.

accepted: She had been waiting for an hour when he finally called

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Ils travaillaient dessus depuis des mois avant que le budget ne tombe.

accepted: They had been working on it for months before the budget came through

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Il était épuisé : il avait présenté toute la journée.

accepted: He was exhausted: he had been presenting all day

exercises.prompt: The room was warm — the heating ___ all night. (run, forme en cours)

accepted: had been running

exercises.prompt: We ___ been queuing for twenty minutes when the doors opened.

accepted: had

exercises.prompt: He started at six. At nine he was still writing.

accepted: By nine he had been writing for three hours

exercises.source: He started at six. At nine he was still writing.

exercises.prompt: She was waiting for two hours when he arrived.

accepted: She had been waiting for two hours when he arrived

exercises.source: She was waiting for two hours when he arrived.

exercises.prompt: The team ___ ___ ___ on the pilot before it was cancelled.

accepted: had been working

fields.regle: have got = have pour la possession, au présent seulement. Au passé, seul had existe.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « J'ai deux frères. » (avec have got)

accepted: I've got two brothers
I have got two brothers

hints: have got exprime la possession au présent.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Est-ce que tu as de la monnaie ? »

accepted: Have you got any change
Do you have any change

hints: Deux tournures possibles : have you got ou do you have.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Nous n'avions pas de voiture à l'époque. »

accepted: We didn't have a car at the time
We did not have a car at the time

hints: Au passé, have got n'existe pas : did not have.

exercises.prompt: ___ a moment? I need your advice. (you / have got)

accepted: Have you got

hints: have got se questionne sans do.

exercises.prompt: We usually ___ breakfast at seven. (have)

accepted: have

hints: have breakfast est une action : jamais have got.

exercises.source: Léon has got a small workshop.
exercises.prompt: Mets la phrase au passé.

accepted: Léon had a small workshop
Leon had a small workshop

hints: Au passé, got disparaît : il ne reste que had.

exercises.source: Do you have got a bike?
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: Have you got a bike
Do you have a bike

hints: On choisit une tournure ou l'autre, jamais les deux.

exercises.prompt: We ___ a lovely time in Porto last spring.

accepted: had

hints: have a good time est une action, et l'action est passée.

fields.regle: have got se limite au présent et dit la possession ou l'état ; have s'emploie partout, et seul lui admet les emplois d'action : have lunch, have a look, have a word.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : As-tu une minute ?

accepted: Have you got a minute
Do you have a minute

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Nous avons déjeuné avec le client.

accepted: We had lunch with the client

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Elle n'a pas de bureau attitré.

accepted: She has not got a desk of her own
She doesn't have a desk of her own

exercises.prompt: I ___ got two direct reports and a contractor.

accepted: have
've

exercises.prompt: Can I ___ a quick word about the deck?

accepted: have

exercises.prompt: Do you have got any questions before we start?

accepted: Have you got any questions before we start
Do you have any questions before we start

exercises.source: Do you have got any questions before we start?
hints: On ne cumule pas do et got.

exercises.prompt: We had got a workshop last Thursday.

accepted: We had a workshop last Thursday

exercises.source: We had got a workshop last Thursday.
hints: have got n'existe pas au passé.

exercises.prompt: Let me ___ a look at the numbers.

accepted: have

fields.regle: used to + base verbale : une habitude ou un état du passé qui n'est plus vrai.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Avant, je buvais du café tous les matins. »

accepted: I used to drink coffee every morning

hints: used to marque une habitude révolue.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Il n'y avait pas de supermarché ici avant. »

accepted: There didn't use to be a supermarket here
There did not use to be a supermarket here

hints: À la forme négative : didn't use to, sans -d.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : « Est-ce que tu jouais au rugby quand tu étais jeune ? »

accepted: Did you use to play rugby when you were young

hints: Question : did + sujet + use to, sans -d.

exercises.prompt: This street ___ much quieter. (used to / be)

accepted: used to be

hints: Un état passé qui a changé.

exercises.prompt: My grandmother ___ her own bread every Sunday. (used to / bake)

accepted: used to bake

exercises.source: Elias played the trumpet for years, but he stopped in 2018.
exercises.prompt: Réécris la première partie avec « used to », en commençant par « Elias ».

accepted: Elias used to play the trumpet

hints: used to suffit à dire que c'est fini.

exercises.source: I didn't used to like olives.
exercises.prompt: Corrige la phrase.

accepted: I didn't use to like olives
I did not use to like olives

hints: Après did, la marque du passé disparaît : use to.

exercises.prompt: There ___ a cinema on this corner.

accepted: used to be

hints: Un lieu qui existait autrefois et plus maintenant.

fields.regle: used to dit une habitude passée qui n'a plus cours : « I used to cycle to work. » Ne pas confondre avec « to be used to -ing », qui dit qu'on y est habitué.

exercises.prompt: Traduis : J'allais au bureau à vélo, avant.

accepted: I used to cycle to work

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Il n'y avait pas de bureaux partagés à l'époque.

accepted: There did not use to be hot-desking then
There didn't use to be hot-desking then

exercises.prompt: Traduis : Maintenant je suis habitué à travailler en anglais.

accepted: I am used to working in English now

hints: be used to + -ing : tout autre chose.

exercises.prompt: The team ___ to meet every Monday, but not any more.

accepted: used

exercises.prompt: She is not used ___ presenting to a board.

accepted: to

exercises.prompt: I smoked for years. I stopped in 2020.

accepted: I used to smoke, but I stopped in 2020

accepted: I am used to working from home on Fridays

exercises.source: I am used to work from home on Fridays.

exercises.prompt: There ___ a cinema where the flats are now.

accepted: used to be
